question.text: A diagonal spread uses options with:

answer.text: Different strike prices AND different expiry dates
Same strike price and same expiry date
Same strike but different expiry dates
Different strikes but same expiry date

explanation.text: The Logic: Vertical spreads use the same expiry with different strikes; horizontal spreads use the same strike with different expiries; diagonal spreads use different expiries as well as different strikes. The Trap: Payoff diagrams CANNOT be drawn for diagonal spreads because the legs have different maturities. Note: Source: NISM-Series-I Currency Derivatives workbook, p.101 and p.107.
